task.description: ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis (handoffs/WF03-ISS0829-20260927/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnosis.json) confirmed the real root cause of ISS-0829: EO-004 and EO-005 in test/letflow/platform/migration_rollout_test.exs assert on GLOBAL rollout state (e.g. rollout.status == "completed", a global tenant/write count, or an already_current check) that Letflow.Platform.MigrationRollout's apply_to_existing_rollout/2 (lib/letflow/platform/migration_rollout.ex:218-256) legitimately recomputes against ALL currently-active company tenants (active_company_tenant_ids/0, lines 423-432) on every call -- a deliberate design choice documented in lib/letflow/design/req374-tenant-migration-fanout-runner.md §9 OQ-1. Under scripts/test_parallel.sh's full parallel-suite load, other concurrently-running test files provisioning/activating tenants in the SAME per-partition database can land in that exact window and inflate/change EO-004/EO-005's global counts, breaking their assertions non-deterministically. This is NOT a production code defect -- it's a test-isolation gap. The adjacent 'queryable outcome record' test in the same file (cited by ISSUE-FIXER, ~lines 288-327) already defends against this exact hazard class (per ISS-0716) using >= comparisons and tenant-scoped filtering instead of exact/global assertions. Design the fix to EO-004 and EO-005 following that same established pattern: scope each test's assertions to the tenants IT created (not global state), using >= or tenant-filtered queries where an exact/global assertion is currently fragile. Write the design to lib/letflow/design/iss0829-migration-rollout-test-isolation.md. Design only -- no test-code edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design identifies the exact assertion(s) in EO-004 and EO-005 that currently depend on global/all-tenant state rather than tenant-scoped state
Design specifies the tenant-scoped replacement for each (following the precedent at ~lines 288-327 of the same file, citing ISS-0716)
Design explicitly confirms no production code (lib/letflow/platform/migration_rollout.ex) needs to change -- this is a test-only fix, matching ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis

Design states how the fix will be verified against the actual race (e.g. re-run under scripts/test_parallel.sh -N 4 repeatedly, or a targeted concurrent-load repro like ISSUE-FIXER's own reproduction attempt)
No implementation code in the design doc
